detaileddescription.para: Provides reproducible latency and throughput measurements for the geographic placement policy and async WAL shipping hot paths, plus simulated multi-writer conflict-rate benchmarks across 3-DC topologies.

sect2.title: Benchmark families

para.heading: RMD-01 — Geo placement: leader candidate selection latency

sect2.para: Inputs: 24-replica 3-DC topology, placement constraints with 1 preferred DC. Gate: p99 ≤ 50 µs.

para.heading: RMD-02 — Geo placement: failover candidate selection latency

sect2.para: Inputs: Same topology; failed node excluded. Gate: p99 ≤ 50 µs.

para.heading: RMD-03 — Geo placement: topology validation latency

sect2.para: Inputs: Same topology; required DC list and min_copies_per_dc=2. Gate: p99 ≤ 100 µs.

para.heading: RMD-04 — Async WAL: enqueue throughput (single producer)

sect2.para: Inputs: 64 KB segments, in-memory no-op ship handler. Gate: ≥ 80 MB/s enqueue throughput (dispatch latency not included).

para.heading: RMD-05 — Async WAL: lag check latency

sect2.para: Inputs: Empty queue. Gate: p99 ≤ 50 µs.

para.heading: RMD-06 — Multi-writer: conflict-rate simulation (8 writers, 3 DCs)

sect2.para: Inputs: 8 concurrent write goroutines each writing to a shared key using LWW resolution (wall-clock simulation). Gate: Conflict rate < 5% (acceptable multi-writer overhead).

para.heading: RMD-07 — Multi-DC: write throughput (simulated cross-DC replication)

sect2.para: Inputs: Batch of 10 000 simulated WAL entries across 3 DCs. Gate: ≥ 10 000 writes/s aggregate throughput.

para.heading: RMD-08 — Async WAL: lag alert fire latency

sect2.para: Inputs: 1 ms max_lag_ms; segment pre-aged by 5 ms. Gate: Alert fires within 2× lag window (≤ 2 ms additional delay).
